<?php
class QuietArrayPayloadReview {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; throw new Exception("payload-array"); }
}
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): array { global $reader; echo "G;"; $reader = null; return [new QuietArrayPayloadReview]; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-array"); }
};
$selector = "items";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->$selector); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "items" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get($incoming): object { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $this; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
};
$selector = "self";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_EMPTY;" : "OBJECT;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "changed" ? "NAME_CHANGED;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
